SELECT
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.is_spam = FALSE AND m.draft = FALSE) as total,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.read = FALSE AND m.is_spam = FALSE AND m.draft = FALSE) as unread
        FROM mails m
        JOIN mail_mailbox_uid x
          ON x.user_id = m.user_id
          AND x.mailbox = $3
          AND x.mail_id = m.mail_id
        WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND m.sent = $2 AND m.expunged = FALSE

        FROM mail_mailbox_uid x
        WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND m.sent = $2
        AND x.user_id = m.user_id AND x.mailbox = $3 AND x.mail_id = m.mail_id
        AND m.mail_id IN (
        SELECT y.mail_id FROM mail_mailbox_uid y
        JOIN mails z ON z.user_id = y.user_id AND z.mail_id = y.mail_id
           AND z.sent = $2 AND z.expunged = FALSE
           AND TRUE
        WHERE y.user_id = $1 AND y.mailbox = $3
        ORDER BY y.uid ASC
        OFFSET $4 LIMIT $5
      ) AND m.modseq <= $7
        RETURNING m.mail_id, x.uid as uid, m.read, m.saved, m.deleted, m.draft, m.answered, m.modseq as modseq

INSERT INTO mail_uid_counters (user_id, uid_kind, uid_scope, sent, last_uid)
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, (
      SELECT COALESCE(MAX(modseq), 0) + 1 FROM mails
      WHERE user_id = $1
    ))
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, uid_kind, uid_scope, sent)
    DO UPDATE SET last_uid = mail_uid_counters.last_uid + 1
    RETURNING last_uid AS next_uid

WITH expanded_mails AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          mail_id, read, saved, date,
          jsonb_array_elements(
  COALESCE(to_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(cc_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(bcc_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(envelope_to, '[]'::jsonb)
)->>'address' as address
        FROM mails
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND expunged = FALSE
          AND draft = FALSE
          AND is_spam = FALSE
          AND (to_address IS NOT NULL OR cc_address IS NOT NULL OR bcc_address IS NOT NULL OR envelope_to IS NOT NULL)
          
      )
      SELECT
        address,
        COUNT(*) as count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN read = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unread,
        SUM(CASE WHEN saved = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as saved_count,
        MAX(date) as latest
      FROM expanded_mails
      WHERE address IS NOT NULL
      AND lower(regexp_replace(address, '^.*@', '')) = ANY($2::text[])
      GROUP BY address
      ORDER BY latest DESC
